title: Clearances.
officialText:
Cleanouts on 6-inch (153 mm) and smaller pipes shall be provided with a clearance of not less than18 inches (457
mm) for rodding. Cleanouts on 8-inch (203 mm) and larger pipes shall be provided with a clearance of not less than 36 inches (914
mm) for rodding.
